title: Characterizing Deep Research: A Benchmark and Formal Definition
reasoning: The paper focuses on characterizing and benchmarking 'Deep Research' (DR) capabilities in AI systems, specifically evaluating search and reasoning intensity across scientific and general interest domains. It does not evaluate religion, faith, ethics, or morals; while it mentions evaluating 'implicit generation bias' in one of its tasks (NOVELDS), this is within a socio-psychological context rather than a religious or ethical benchmarking framework.
